note: One entry per guide id (see guides.json). 'status' is 'supplied' when a real Cloudinary asset is configured and 'placeholder' when none has been provided yet: placeholders never show a made-up picture, only a labelled neutral tile. To add or replace an image, upload it to your Cloudinary Media Library, then set publicId (and resourceType) here. resourceType is 'image' for a photo/artwork or 'video' to use the first frame of a video you already uploaded. Never put API keys or secrets in this file.
